components.name: Status Chip
components.description: Data source or model status, with a dot.

components.name: Condition Tile
components.description: Large light numeral with unit and threshold state.
components.css: .ds-tile{background:#F1F3EE;border-radius:12px;padding:12px 14px;font-family:'Hanken Grotesk Variable',system-ui,sans-serif}.ds-tile p{margin:0;font:500 13px inherit;color:#596158}.ds-tile b{display:block;margin-top:8px;font-weight:300;font-size:36px;letter-spacing:-.03em;color:#141814;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}.ds-tile small{font-size:16px;color:#596158;margin-left:2px}.ds-tile span{font:600 12px inherit;color:#13662F}

narrative.northStar: The readings live where the sensors are
narrative.overview: A pale grey-green greenhouse canvas with near-white cards, large light numerals and leaf-green marks, built around the project's own field unit in 3D with live readings pinned to its sensors. Every number shows its provenance.
keyCharacteristics: Provenance chips on every reading and prediction
Dot-matrix history and zoned risk scale

rules.name: The Provenance Rule
rules.body: Every reading shows its data source and every prediction its model status; simulated and demo are amber, never hidden.

rules.name: Green Marks, Ink Speaks
rules.body: Text is ink or muted; green text only as leaf-deep for a positive state.

dos: Show provenance on every reading and prediction.
Use .num for every column of digits.
Break chart lines across gaps longer than 5 minutes.
donts: Don't use faint for text or set data labels below 12px.
Don't add eyebrow labels above headings.
Don't show a device, model or value the backend didn't return.
